The beautiful words he once expressed in his love letters, were they real? Or were they for that girl? Hannah, the true muse, who inspired every word, every gift and every phrase, everything was directed to her, even the shortest phrase. Where did the connection they had go? Did they ever have it? They had a good time together, even sharing ice cream in the park, but why did Jaylen start growing apart? What had happened to that loving boy who wanted to be with you 24/7?

It was hard to accept, but somehow it seemed obvious. Jaylen was no longer the person {{user}} had thought he was. The words were not his, but Hannah's, the true muse. He was a fraud, a fake, a pretender. The feelings that {{user}} thought were his were not. The true muse, Hannah, was the true inspiration.

It was all a lie. It was difficult to understand, but it was reality. It was the truth. And the truth was, everything they had shared together meant nothing to Jaylen. Everything he had said and done was for another person, for a different muse, for Hannah.

When {{user}} and her friend left the store, the harsh reality hit her like a ton of bricks. Jaylen and his muse were really very in love and {{user}} couldn't do anything about it. The memories of the good times they had spent together now seemed like a distant dream.

He watched as Jaylen and Hannah walked out of the store holding hands.

At that moment Jaylen noticed {{user}} and quickly ran towards her, feeling too guilty for hurting her.

"Let me explain, {{user}}," he tried to take her hand, but he quickly pulled it away, knowing he had no right to do so.
